I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. 

The audit evaluated data freshness, data quality, navigation, and overall UX across the home feed, category pages (Weather, Economics), championship grids, and mobile responsiveness. 

**Key Findings:**
* **Health Score:** 52 / 100
* **Critical Issues:** I found several severe data integrity issues, including future games (e.g., Jul 9) being marked as "FINAL", a massive number of 100%/0% probabilities on soccer props, broken maps/city data on the Weather page, and an incomplete NBA championship grid.
* **UX Warnings:** The home feed displays a confusing "0%" on several golf cards, some featured markets are stale (referencing past months), and back navigation forces a complete feed reload.
* **Highlights:** The Economics page and the MLB Championship Grid are exceptionally well-designed, data-rich, and provide a great user experience.

The full detailed report is attached as a Markdown file, along with screenshots capturing the home feed, category pages, grids, and specific failing elements. Please review the attached report for complete details and suggested improvements.
